forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MPFEP97Z6J3R0MRC6XXKAJ
+- 01M1MPD4MJ9KMVVQ316YSJPJHK
+- 01M1MPECJSM165NAWX5F3NKX9A
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: Wire --frames into run, and prove the stdout and stderr rules end to end
+---
+## What
+
+`cli-plan.md` §8 and the §14 rows about stdout cleanliness. The unit tests
+drive the turn logic over an in-memory pair; this task runs the real binary
+against a real agent process and asserts the two streams byte for byte. It is
+the only way to prove §8, because §8 is a claim about file descriptors.
+
+Edit `Sources/acp-client/RunCommand.swift`: when `--frames` is given, wrap the
+`AgentProcess` transport in `FrameTeeTransport` before handing it to
+`connect(over:)`, with the tee's sink pointed at stderr. `--frames` is
+independent of `--quiet` and `--verbose`: it is a debugging switch, not a
+verbosity level, and it writes its lines whether or not stderr is a terminal.
+
+Add
+`IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientIntegrationTests/RunCommandTests.swift`,
+built on the `CLITestSupport` and `StubAgents` helpers.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] With `wellBehavedAgent`, `acp-client run "hi" -- <agent>` writes only the
+      answer text to stdout, byte for byte, with no trailing newline.
+- [ ] The same run, with stderr captured as a pipe, writes zero bytes to
+      stderr.
+- [ ] `--quiet` writes zero bytes to stderr and leaves stdout unchanged.
+- [ ] `--verbose` writes session event lines to stderr and leaves stdout
+      unchanged, byte for byte.
+- [ ] `--frames` writes the ndJSON messages to stderr in both directions, and
+      stdout stays exactly the answer text.
+- [ ] The arguments after `--` reach the agent unchanged, flags included.
+- [ ] `acp-client run` with no `--` writes usage to stderr, writes nothing to
+      stdout, and exits 2.
+- [ ] Each of the §7 prompt-source rows behaves as the table says when driven
+      through the real binary: an argument, a piped stdin, and `-`.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `RunCommandTests.swift`, one test per acceptance row above, each using
+      `runAcpClient(_:standardInput:)` and asserting on `Data`, not `String`.
+- [ ] One test extends `wellBehavedAgent` to echo its own `argv` into a file,
+      and asserts the file holds the arguments given after `--` in order.
+- [ ] One test asserts stdout and stderr never interleave: with `--frames`,
+      the stdout bytes still equal the answer text alone.
+- [ ] One test asserts the answer text is identical with stdout a pipe and
+      with stdout a file, which pins the "no rule that changes with a
+      terminal" claim of §8.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests`. Every assertion
+      passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
